title: Noir beta.22 ACIR support, semantic constraint checking, and WarpToad artifact correspondence

source_correspondence.compile: Use the exact beta.22 Nargo release on the exact pinned WarpToad checkout in an isolated copied source tree under D1P-13.
compare: artifact bytecode bytes and decoded semantic program
typed ABI including visibility and order
verification key generated by locked @aztec/bb.js 5.0.0 with keccakZK:true
nonsemantic metadata including paths, debug information and JSON field ordering
source_correspondence.classification: Classify differences as semantic or nonsemantic with a checked justification. Correspondence remains OPEN unless bytecode/decoded constraints, ABI and VK match.
source_correspondence.prior_proof_boundary: D1P-12R validates only the committed artifact/verifier route. It is not evidence that a rebuilt artifact corresponds.

decoder.new_module: Separate beta.22 decoder; beta.14 module remains byte-unchanged.
decoder.parse_vs_semantics: Parsing support does not imply semantic-check support.
decoder.fail_closed: Every unknown opcode, black-box function, Brillig form, memory form or noncanonical encoding raises a named unsupported reason; nothing is skipped.

semantic_check.input: Execute the committed artifact with the exact D1P-12R honest proofInputs to recover its witness without generating a proof.
semantic_check.supported: Evaluate every decoded constraint whose semantics are implemented; report per-kind totals and satisfaction.
semantic_check.unsupported: Inventory each unsupported proof-enforced opcode separately from witness-generation-only Brillig/bytecode machinery.
semantic_check.claim_rule: No whole-circuit satisfaction or security claim follows while any proof-enforced semantic element is unsupported.

mutations.freeze_rule: Write the exact witness indices, original/replacement values, dependency provenance and expected failing supported constraint before evaluating any mutation.
mutations.selection_rule: Select only values whose failure follows from a decoded supported constraint. Do not select unknown, inactive, unconstrained or witness-generation-only values merely to demand a failure.
mutations.outcome_rule: Record expected and observed results for each mutation; an observed pass is reported honestly and does not retroactively change the expectation.

public_inputs.requirement: Map decoded public witness identifiers to all eleven consumer positions and retain exact conversion/provenance distinctions.

result_boundary: D1 verdict remains UNKNOWN. Decoder and component semantic checks are development evidence, not a joint proof-to-effect result.
